column1: # Ordered queue consumed one entry per tick by scripts/upstream-adopt/adopt-next.sh.
# Every SHA here was TRIALLED with `git cherry-pick -n` against origin/develop and
# applied without conflict. That is measured, not inferred: a static "touches no
# diverged file" heuristic predicted 178 clean and only 110 actually were (~62%
# precise), so entries are trial-verified rather than classified.
# Tier order is risk-ascending, which is also the execution order:
#   T0-zero-runtime-risk  test/ci/chore/docs only. Cannot change runtime behaviour.
#                         Warms the later merge by retiring test-file divergence.
#   DEFER-feature         feat/perf. NOT adopted here. Feature-shaped changes belong
#                         in the deliberate merge, not in an unattended trickle.
# PINNED-FIRST is the single exception to tier order: upstream #5276 is on the
# critical path of gcw-qap3 (it fixes PrimeActive swallowing partial reads — the
# exact function our preserved summary-envelope test names). Taking it first stops
# further fork-local gcw-qap3 work being written against code upstream replaced.
# It touches one diverged file, docs/reference/cli.md, which is GENERATED — resolve
